title: Chapter 184
text:
A tanky rare talent that had yet to reach the level of a Molding Talent allowed Han Xiao to become even more tanky.

He remembered that Hella also had a recovery talent, and the effect of [Extraordinary Physique] was similar. It also gave him an additional three hundred health points.

"Is it really a good idea for a Mechanic like me to become so meaty?" Han Xiao did not know whether to laugh or cry. This was forcing him to use his physical body to fight head-on. He felt that if this continued, his image would be destroyed. He only wanted to be a technical Mechanic quietly. Melee combat was all brash!

I have to find some offensive talents or talents, but these types of Molding Talents are too rare. Most of the Molding Talents are defensive or amplification types.

As a Mechanic, talents that were compatible with his machinery were what he needed the most. Han Xiao had been triggering a talent, [Lethal Shot]. Although it was not a Molding Talent, its effect was not bad. It required him to deal a huge amount of damage to a target of at least the same level with a firearm. He had done it nearly forty times, but enemies of the same level were getting harder and harder to find, so it would take him some time to complete it.

As for the temporary enhancement potions, he planned to use some on the rapid injection module of the mechanical suit. He would save the rest and find a chance to sell them for quite a sum. It would be best if he sold them to the players.

Among these potions, there was one that was in an incomplete state, and there was only one.

Unknown Potion: A semi-finished product of a certain potion. Effect unknown.

The color was clear and transparent like water. Usually, unknown things would have unexpected effects. Han Xiao had a feeling that this thing was not simple, but he would not use it when the effect was not clear.

The Louis Research Institution might complete the research in the future. I'll come back then, and I'll know the effect of the finished product. Han Xiao raised his eyebrows.

If he wanted to make potions, he would have to change his profession to [Pharmacist] or have the knowledge of potions from the Mage class. Han Xiao was not interested in making potions, and he felt that making potions was different from making machines. Potions required a strict mixture of materials and a strict production process. The slightest mistake would result in failure, and the channeling process was much easier.

In the afternoon, Han Xiao snuck out of Cambus. He still had a mission to intimidate in Maple. The few officials that Bennett wanted him to intimidate all lived in the capital of Maple. The two scouts were already on standby in Maple City.

The capital of Maple was called Karimochi, which meant Maple Leaf City.

…

The financial group behind the Louis Research Institution immediately posted a bounty on the Dark Web. The target was none other than "Heisenberg". The bounty included the face Han Xiao had used in the research institution and a short surveillance video of him wearing a mecha and rushing out of the research institution.

The Germinal Organization soon saw the report.

"There is no such executive in the organization."

The leader was surprised. The organization only had a few hidden intelligence personnel and spies left in other continents. He didn't let anyone rob a civilian research institute. There was only one possibility. This "Heisenberg" was a fake and deliberately used the Germinal Organization as an excuse.

In fact, he did not even think that this was framing … because framing the Germinal Organization was completely unnecessary. Now that the whole world was targeting them, they did not care about having one more enemy.

Ever since the Germinal Organization became a dog in the water, every cat and dog thought of them as a toothless tiger, adding insult to injury. Where did this Heisenberg come from?

The leader's focus was on the performance of the mecha. He was surprised to find that this mecha was even more advanced than the organization's technology. Even the super soldier experiment that had been making breakthroughs did not reach this level of practicality.

"If we can get the technology of this mecha, the organization's individual combat ability will improve by leaps and bounds. Which organization developed this new mecha? If it's an enemy … "

The leader's hand that was holding the corner of the table tightened, leaving clear fingerprints on the steel table. With a serious tone, he ordered, "Let the intelligence network secretly pay attention to the whereabouts of the user of this mecha. I want to know everything about him."

Unfortunately, this was the only time Han Xiao's mecha was observed. The Germinal Organization's intelligence personnel did not find any more information. It was extremely mysterious.

"The organization that can develop this kind of mecha must have a huge amount of resources." The leader felt like he had found the tip of the iceberg of a hidden organization. Unfortunately, there were no clues, so he could only leave it as it was.

He calmed himself down and asked about another matter, "How is the capture of the Inhumans going?"

The deputy took out the file and said, "So far, 2,103 Inhumans have been captured. Originally, the Inhumans were gathered in a few fixed locations. They were actively avoiding our capture and scattered to other areas. More and more of them are resisting arrest, and our operations are being hindered."

"Mr. Cyberlos has a new theory. Through experiments, it shows that even if these Inhumans are not brainwashed, they will accept all kinds of employment. Their actions are very purposeful. The Inhumans do not understand a lot of common knowledge, and they talk strangely. Also, the Inhumans seem to have a special way of communicating with each other. Some Inhumans know each other. The reason is still under investigation, but there is no more progress. 'These Inhumans are more like ancient people from the past.' Er, that was Mr. Cyberlos's original words. "

"What is the Six Nations' reaction to the Inhumans?"

"The intelligence network shows that the Six Nations have already sent out their own teams to contact the Inhumans. Their attitudes are different, some are gentle, some are tough …"

The leader nodded and said in a low voice, "They have stopped their war preparations, but they won't stop forever. Agents from various countries have infiltrated Andrea and found them. I want their every move to be under our surveillance. I have a feeling that the Inhumans will be our chance to win this war."

…

The lens of the sunglasses reflected the appearance of a luxurious villa, and the plainclothes secret service personnel patrolling the inside and outside of the manor at all times. The Caucasian old man, who was dressed like a homeless man, pushed his sunglasses up, touched the round hat that covered his bald head, and the mini earpiece hidden in the round hat.

"Duplex four-story villa. The entrance of the manor needs to be opened by the internal system. There are two standard secret service teams patrolling outside the manor, and there is one team inside. There are a total of eighteen secret service members. The target leaves the house at eight in the morning every day and takes a bulletproof car. The two teams follow and protect him. He has his lunch at the restaurant in the government building and returns home between six and seven in the evening.

Hannes held his sunglasses and spoke softly into the earpiece. "The target lives in the political district of Maple. There are many patrolling police and sentries on the road. If you want to make a move on the road, you better do it quickly."

A calm female voice came out of the earpiece. Vernina said lightly, "Then do it on the road. Remind me of those old days." Hannes was dissatisfied.

"I'm crazy. I'm already retired, but I still have to work with you guys. Also, it's kidnapping an important official in Maple. Damn it, Gerian, why did you have to find me? Why couldn't you find Bennett? That guy is still fighting on the front line. Why did you have to find me, a retired old man? Can't you just let me have a few years of peace?"

"Humph, you owe me a favor. Also, I don't like Bennett. That guy left me three muzzles thirty-three years ago." A third person's voice sounded from the headset. Gerian was a burly man, and his voice was like a cannon. "Don't complain all day like a sissy. Did the days of leisurely planting vegetables and waiting for death wear down your toughness and turn you into a spineless sissy?"

"Gentlemen, don't forget that there's a woman here," Vernina said calmly.

"I'm already sixty-eight years old. You're one year older than me. It's not normal for you to still think about fighting and killing." Hannes was speechless.

"Humph, not even seventy years old. Is that old?" Gerian muttered for a while, then changed his tone and said seriously, "There will be patrolling police around the corner in nine seconds. Be careful and hide."

Hannes bent his back, and his aura suddenly became inconspicuous. Nine seconds later, a patrolling police officer walked out from the corner. When he saw Hannes, he walked up and yelled, "Check your ID!"

Hannes took out a fake ID. The police officer looked at it and handed it back. He yelled, "Don't stay here. Go away."

Hannes walked slowly like an old man. After he turned the corner, his steps became lighter. He whispered, "There are too many patrolling police and sentries in this area. If you want to kidnap the target silently, it's best to do it at night."
